action.objective: Commit the verified Bd6, winning a knight; develop/centralize while staying safe from Qxc3+.
action.rationale: b8d6 is the only commit_ready_move: exact broad score 428 at depth 3, single-candidate verification complete with no immediate mate and no tactical refutation found. It captures the knight on b8 (Black's c8 queen cannot recapture effectively since Bxb8 already took the piece; material is won). No alternatives have usable verification.
